### 3 Reasons 'Peace Be With You' Is Far More Than a Platitude
Author: Clarence L. Haynes Jr.
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/reasons-peace-be-with-you-is-far-more-than-a-platitude.html
Passage: John 20:19
Points:
- Christ's greeting of peace conveys genuine wholeness and quiet rest rather than a mere social formality.
- Jesus directly confronts fear and anxiety, stepping past locked doors into the disciples' isolation.
- God takes the initiative to pursue and comfort His people when they are troubled and afraid.
- Divine peace is purposeful, designed to free believers from paralysis so they can be sent into ministry.
